svg.title: An AERI run, start to finish: one terminal drives the robot, the page and the vision model watch, answer and label
svg.desc: A swim-lane flow of one real-robot evaluation with the automatic pipeline (AERI). Prepare: the robot stack, the job, binding and contract, a read-only check. Start: the typed execute phrase, a start summary, the start-pose check and the policy warm-up. Every round: set the scene, answer the scene question, the policy acts, an event candidate, the vision judgement, stop when done, home and verify, the reset prompt. Exceptions: an unknown verdict is never a success, event contract violations turn events off for the round, a fault locks the run, a stop is possible at any time. End: summary, metrics, labels and the run journal. Only terminal D sends motion. Status: the round loop, judging, the home check and page tracking are in main; the one-terminal console, the start checks, the policy unit D starts itself and terminal-only resume are on the integration branch, not yet in main; pausing the policy to judge and the handling of other event adapter errors are planned; hardware acceptance pending.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
